title: Momoi Airi — Profile Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, lemme get started!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One special delivery of love coming right up! From MORE MORE JUMP!, it's the lovely fairy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Airi!
Airi Momoi at your service☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since you guys requested that we give our self-intros, I wanna take this opportunity to introduce myself to those who don't know about me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm...?
This person said...
“Not many people don't know who you are, Airi.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What they're getting at is, the girl you see here was once a cornerstone of primetime variety shows!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
“You were funnier than a lot of those comedians”?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's my personal policy to go all out no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, back then, I wasn't a part of MORE MORE JUMP! That was when I was a member of a group called QT.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That group kept me so busy.
They had me sing, dance and do all those variety shows!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of all the things I did, Happy Everyday, the Masked Variety Idol, was probably one of my biggest hits...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Even now, people walking by will sometimes say, “Hey, it's Happy Everyday!”
Hehe. That always puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I became modestly successful...
But there came a time when I had to ask myself what kind of idol I wanted to be.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
One thing led to another...
And now, I'm freelancing as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Things were pretty rough at first.
Especially since we didn't have an agency backing us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Which meant no manager.
On top of having to put our own schedules together, we had to come up with ideas and scripts for our streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We didn't know how to do any of those things initially, so we had to learn.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fortunately, we had some help along the way. With our songs for one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And our Christmas event. It wouldn't have been possible without the help of our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We ran into some trouble that time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I had a lot of fun working with everyone! I mean, as an idol, you'd normally never get to put an event together from scratch like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I felt that getting to interact so closely with you guys is one of the best parts of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That includes getting to see all of your guys' comments! I'm always happy I get to hear how you feel in real time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we're gonna stick to this style.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lately, some of you have said you're worried we won't be able to do all the things we have been because of our increased media exposure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But don't worry.
What we do isn't gonna change moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're still right here.
And we're gonna keep spreading as much hope as we can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support!
